definition: Correct for this style, though not its first choice. Unlike an atypical option, it needs no special reason: a three-bay centred front is permitted in Georgian, for smaller houses and urban lots.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a variant's status: "permitted: correct but not first choice. atypical: defensible only with a reason." kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json composition_parti.variants[three-bay-centred].note: "Smaller houses and urban lots."
